description: Returns available and saved filters for a project tool tab.

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: Tool tab whose filters are listed. Required unless `tool` is `generic_tool`.

200.description: Available and saved filters for the requested tool tab.

index.description: Zero-based position of this filter in the list.

key.description: Filter name used when requesting options or saving sticky filters.

endpoint.description: Relative URL path for fetching this filter's options.

type.description: Optional UI control type for the filter (for example `calendar` or `checkboxGroup`).

saved_filters.description: Sticky filter selections previously saved for the tool tab.

value.description: Selected values for this sticky filter.
